title: Neon Plasma Armory Shield-Only Integrity States

items.name: Plasma Shield
items.impact_description: One isolated compact shield-hit reaction with branching cyan cracks and a restrained violet stress flare spreading from one contact point; effect fragments only, not a complete shield.
items.break_description: One isolated circular scattering pattern of cyan plasma shield fragments and restrained violet energy shards, leaving an empty transparent center and clearly reading as a force field breaking apart.
